instruction: OK.メモ作成。対応を始める。

approved.deployment_topology: build a versioned stable package from a Deployment Manifest allowlist and connect the target project through Integration Manifest and Project Binding
approved.project_artifact_boundary: .reviewcompass/workflow/ is the stable project-side root; deployment package updates do not move or rewrite canonical workflow records
approved.record_identity_rule: Issue, Plan, Decision, Challenge, Verdict and Evidence remain separate records connected by ID, version, digest and relation kind
approved.self_application_rule: generate stable deployment from an approved snapshot and keep it separate from development source, state and data
approved.migration_rule: semantic Project Artifact migration is exceptional and Human-approved, not an ordinary remedy for directory design changes

corrective_scope: record the adopted deployment and Project Artifact boundary
prepare a successor Layout Baseline candidate
add test-first normal, negative and boundary fixtures
make the minimum validator changes required by the successor baseline
reverify the successor baseline before creating Issue Pilot records
preserved_constraints: do not edit fixed predecessor Evidence in place
do not edit Layout Baseline v1 or Work 1A Evidence v1 in place
do not create actual Issue Pilot records before the successor layout is verified and approved
do not formalize the product Issue Resolution schema or Workflow permit in this corrective
do not implement the complete Work 7A or Work 7B deployment lifecycle in this corrective
do not commit or push without a separate Human instruction
next_action: create Layout Baseline v2 candidate and RED tests for the workflow root and no-move package boundary
